about_the_game:
Overview

This is a survival-adventure game set in the realm of dreams. After a mysterious accident, you awaken in a surreal world to find yourself completely isolated, with your memories gone. You must explore the unknown, gather resources, confront various nightmares, and uncover the secrets of this world.

Core Gameplay

  • Exploration: Freely explore an ever-changing dreamscape, from serene landscapes of memory to twisted lairs of nightmares. Every corner holds valuable resources and deadly dangers.

  • Survival & Building: Gather and hunt to accumulate essential resources for survival. Recruit villagers, build shelters, and gradually develop a thriving settlement. Manage farms, raise livestock, and establish a solid logistical foundation for your adventure.

  • Combat: Battle against bizarre and ever-changing nightmares. Craft weapons and gear, learn ancient and powerful magic, and recruit loyal warriors to fight by your side as you carve a path through this perilous world.

Game Goal

Your primary task is to survive and expand your settlement. At the same time, search for memory fragments scattered throughout the world, piece together the clues, and uncover the truth behind your entrapment. Find your way home before your sanity runs out.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows10
  • Processor: Intel i5-7500 or AMD R5-1500
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX950 or AMD RX560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: windows10
  • Processor: Intel i7-7700 or AMD R7-1700
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX1070 or AMD RX Vega56
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: This is a survival-adventure game set in the realm of dreams. Players will assume the role of a lost soul who awakens in a surreal world with fragmented memories. To find their way home, they must gather resources, develop strength to confront various nightmares, and follow clues to uncover the truth.
